title: Download the Rerun desktop app
headline: Rerun on your desktop
description: Your coworkers in a window of their own, with notifications, an icon in the menu bar or the system tray, and Quick ask.
requirements: macOS 13 or later, Apple Silicon and Intel.
otherPlatforms: Windows and Linux are on the way. Until then, Rerun runs in your browser.
webApp: Rerun also runs in your browser: <link>open the web app</link>.

mac.name: macOS
mac.requirements: macOS 13 or later, Apple Silicon and Intel.

windows.name: Windows
windows.requirements: Windows 10 or later, x64 and Arm.
windows.warning: The Windows app is not signed yet. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click More info, then Run anyway.

linux.name: Linux
linux.requirements: x64. The AppImage runs on most distributions and updates itself.

features.label: What the app adds
features.title: Everything in Rerun, a shortcut away

notifications.title: Notifications that bring you back
notifications.body: Your coworkers reach you as soon as you are in another app, and a click opens the conversation.

quickAsk.title: Quick ask
quickAsk.body: ⌘⇧Space on a Mac, Ctrl+Shift+Space on Windows and Linux: a question for your Chief of Staff from any app, and the answer waits in Rerun.

always.title: Always running
always.body: Closing the window keeps Rerun in the menu bar or the system tray, with the count of what waits for you on its icon.
